title: LockStorage
description: A Minecraft utility mod that prevents the game from opening storage GUIs like Ender chests, furnaces, and more! Great if you accidentally keep opening storage GUIs.
body:
# Minecraft Fabric mod to force cancels most block GUI'S
Great of u have problem with people using enderchest meta


## Features
- Blocks access to most of the storage rlated blocks
- Keybind to toggle
- saves Config
